name: nDPI
description_en: Open Source Deep Packet Inspection Software Toolkit
readme_excerpt: nDPI What is nDPI ? nDPI® is an open source LGPLv3 library for deep-packet inspection. Some dissectors are released under a dual-license: please refer to README.license.md for more information.
